_comment: M28.4.2 create_data_asset_instance soak-only. UDataAsset is not in the inventory pipeline's logic-bearing set (PROJECT_INVENTORY_BRIEF.md §3), so the inspect harness's re-export phase emits zero .md and the inspect gate would always fail. Expanding inventory scope is a separate design decision; for M28.4.2 we keep inspect skipped via `skip_inspect: true` and rely on soak for the determinism signal. The soak gate validates byte-identity of the scratch .uasset across 2 rounds of create_data_asset_instance — trivially stable since the duplicate pre-places a DA instance at scratch_path and the op short-circuits on StaticLoadObject hit (skipped="asset already exists", no save path exercised on round 2). The actual create-from-scratch path is covered by MCP pytest's get_op_catalog coverage + manual editor verification. UDataAsset / UPrimaryDataAsset have zero FGuid::NewGuid() usage per the M28.4.0 research so no seed recipe is needed; explicit FName on NewObject (derived from the short-name tail) is the only determinism lever.
